2] This is the applicant's second bail application filed under Section 483 of B.N.S.S./ 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973, as he/ she is implicated in connection with Crime No.898/2024 registered at Police Station Rajendra Nagar, District Indore (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467,
468, 469, 471, 120-B and 201 of IPC .

entities.text: Police Station Rajendra Nagar, District Indore
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 26.12.2024.
His first bail application M.Cr.C. No.19729 of 2025 was dismissed by this Court vide order dated 16.05.2025 on merits.

3] The allegation against the applicant is of fraud along with the other accused persons to the tune of Rs.7,18,31,277/-, as the accused persons opened an NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:32236 2 MCRC-43720-2025 account in the name of Indore Development Authority Tree Manufacturing and sold plots in the name of the said Authority fraudulently and only with a view to defraud the innocent purchasers.
In the account of the said Authority, a total amount of Rs.16,02,88,070/- was found to be transacted.

4] Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the main accused in the present case happens to be the brother-in-law of the applicant, Hitesh Sharma,

. 5] Counsel for the State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer, and it is submitted that looking to the earlier dismissal on merits, no case for grant of bail is made out.

Having considered the rival submissions, on perusal of the case- diary, and taking note of the role assigned to the present applicant Rajesh Vyas, whose name also finds place in the FIR itself along with the other accused persons, Hitesh Sharma, who has died, and his wife Neelu Sharma,
who is still absconding, this Court does not find it to be a fit case for grant of bail.
8] However, the applicant shall be at liberty to renew material witnesses are examined in the Trial Court.
